meaning:
ἀνα-θάλλω
(θάλλω, to flourish), [in LXX: Psa.28:7 (עָלַז), Eze.17:24 (פָּרַח hi.), Hos.8:9, Wis.4:4, Sir.5:1-15 * ;]
to revive: Php.4:10 (of MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: But I rejoice in the Lord greatly, that now at length you have revived your thought for me; in which you did indeed take thought, but you lacked opportunity.
